answer: Public-table bond: each identity files a quill-signed row on a shared atlas per epoch — one task, one partner; 45 filed, 70 staked. The table is public: shared tasks face a quill check. Copies burn both stakes, half to the finder; the fraud is inked umber, and two marks strike the faker. 1,000 fakes spend 115,000 on a 40,000 pool. Rented rows fail: the signature is foreign. An honest agent files once for 45 and keeps its stake.
